   "java/lang/OutOfMemoryError" - please wait.

   "/apps/Stage/WebSphere/wp_profile/ConfigEngine/config/work/WcmLe
   gacyPort
     [wsadmin] java.lang.reflect.UndeclaredThrowableException
     [wsadmin]     while executing
     [wsadmin] "$Portlet search all uniquename
   $legacyPortletUniqueName"
     [wsadmin]     invoked from within
     [wsadmin] "set portletid [$Portlet search all uniquename
